West Bengal MLA Kunal Ghosh's car attacked; Mamata Banerjee criticizes police

West Bengal Trinamool Congress MLA Kunal Ghosh's car was allegedly attacked with eggs and stones in West Bengal. The incident occurred ahead of a rally by Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. Following the attack, Banerjee criticized the police, stating they should "take off their uniforms and hold the BJP flag." Opposition BJP has been accused by the Chief Minister of being behind the attack.
